<thought>To calculate DBE for C12H15O4, use the standard formula DBE = (2*C + 2 - H)/2 (oxygen is ignored). Plugging in C=12, H=15 gives (24+2-15)/2 = 11/2 = 5.5. Since DBE must be an integer for neutral molecules, the nearest whole number is 6. I will provide 6 as the integer DBE.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
